headline: Ready to try on your iPhone
next_for_owner: Install Expo Go from the App Store on your iPhone (Satchel now targets SDK 58, the version Expo Go runs).

On your PC, download the trial kit from this page, unzip it and double-click START_TRIAL.cmd (it installs, runs npx expo install --fix, checks the code, then starts Satchel). If anything is red, paste trial-log.txt into a comment here. The Desktop\Apps\satchel copy is an older build until a run refreshes it.
When the QR code appears, scan it with the iPhone Camera app and open it in Expo Go.
Try the demo trip, then turn on flight mode and try again. Comment on this page with anything that looks wrong (docs/TRIAL.md has yes/no questions).
Full install + tsc + expo export needs PC verification (T34): connect Desktop\Apps to a build run, or run START_TRIAL.cmd and paste trial-log.txt here.
